name: Bank Transactions
description: Consolidated Raw Data block only; account-level repeats excluded. INR. Source category and counterparty retained; unidentified entries remain unidentified.

name: Bank Monthly
description: Consolidated MoM Summary only. Dashes are missing/not reported, not imputed zero. BTO is source-reported net credits, with gross credits available separately.
mExpression:
let
  Rows = Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("", BinaryEncoding.Base64), Compression.GZip)),
  Data = Table.FromRows(Rows, {"Month","Gross Debits","Gross Credits","Net Debits","Net Credits","Net Debit Count","Net Credit Count","Inward Bounce Count","Inward Bounce Amount","EMI Bounce Count","EMI Bounce Amount","Penal Charges","Loan Disbursements","EMI Payments","Interest Paid","Missing Statement Dates"}),
  Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Data, {{"Month", type nullable date},{"Gross Debits", type nullable number},{"Gross Credits", type nullable number},{"Net Debits", type nullable number},{"Net Credits", type nullable number},{"Net Debit Count", type nullable number},{"Net Credit Count", type nullable number},{"Inward Bounce Count", type nullable number},{"Inward Bounce Amount", type nullable number},{"EMI Bounce Count", type nullable number},{"EMI Bounce Amount", type nullable number},{"Penal Charges", type nullable number},{"Loan Disbursements", type nullable number},{"EMI Payments", type nullable number},{"Interest Paid", type nullable number},{"Missing Statement Dates", type text}}, "en-US")
in Typed

name: GST Monthly
description: Monthly adjusted taxable values from Bifurcation; annual totals and overlapping TTM columns excluded. INR, excludes GST tax amounts.
mExpression:
let
  Rows = Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("", BinaryEncoding.Base64), Compression.GZip)),
  Data = Table.FromRows(Rows, {"Month","Revenue","Domestic Revenue","Export Revenue","Purchases and Expenses"}),
  Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Data, {{"Month", type nullable date},{"Revenue", type nullable number},{"Domestic Revenue", type nullable number},{"Export Revenue", type nullable number},{"Purchases and Expenses", type nullable number}}, "en-US")
in Typed

name: GST Parties
description: Nonzero monthly party taxable values. GSTIN-valid detail rows only; totals, annual and TTM columns excluded. Buyer/supplier shares use party totals in selected periods.
mExpression:
let
  Rows = Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("", BinaryEncoding.Base64), Compression.GZip)),
  Data = Table.FromRows(Rows, {"Month","Role","Party","Party Key","GSTIN","Amount","Source Row"}),
  Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Data, {{"Month", type nullable date},{"Role", type text},{"Party", type text},{"Party Key", type text},{"GSTIN", type text},{"Amount", type nullable number},{"Source Row", type nullable number}}, "en-US")
in Typed

name: GST State
description: State-wise taxable values. Exports and exempt/nil/non-GST buckets retained by source label. Subtotals excluded.
mExpression:
let
  Rows = Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("", BinaryEncoding.Base64), Compression.GZip)),
  Data = Table.FromRows(Rows, {"Month","Type","State","State Code","Amount"}),
  Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Data, {{"Month", type nullable date},{"Type", type text},{"State", type text},{"State Code", type text},{"Amount", type nullable number}}, "en-US")
in Typed

name: GST Filings
description: GSTR1/GSTR3B filing details. Delay recomputed from supplied due and filing dates, floored at zero; source delay retained. Late fee amounts are not supplied.
mExpression:
let
  Rows = Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("", BinaryEncoding.Base64), Compression.GZip)),
  Data = Table.FromRows(Rows, {"Month","GSTIN","State","Return","Due Date","Filing Date","Delay Days","Source Delay Days","Source Row"}),
  Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Data, {{"Month", type nullable date},{"GSTIN", type text},{"State", type text},{"Return", type text},{"Due Date", type nullable date},{"Filing Date", type nullable date},{"Delay Days", type nullable number},{"Source Delay Days", type nullable number},{"Source Row", type nullable number}}, "en-US")
in Typed

name: Financials
description: Statement values in INR for FY2021-22 to FY2023-24. Uses detailed Balance Sheet and Profit & Loss; source narrative/snapshot inconsistencies do not override statements. Reserves and surplus is only a retained-earnings proxy.
mExpression:
let
  Rows = Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("", BinaryEncoding.Base64), Compression.GZip)),
  Data = Table.FromRows(Rows, {"Financial Year","Sales","Total Income","Total Expenses","Net Profit","Profit Before Tax","Interest","Current Tax","Deferred Tax","Depreciation and Amortization","Reported EBITDA","Other Income","Purchases","Inventory Change","Material Consumed","Equity","Long Term Debt","Short Term Debt","Unsecured Long Term Debt","Unsecured Short Term Debt","Current Assets","Current Liabilities","Inventory","Debtors","Creditors","Intangible Assets","Retained Earnings Proxy","Non Current Liabilities","Total Assets"}),
  Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Data, {{"Financial Year", type text},{"Sales", type nullable number},{"Total Income", type nullable number},{"Total Expenses", type nullable number},{"Net Profit", type nullable number},{"Profit Before Tax", type nullable number},{"Interest", type nullable number},{"Current Tax", type nullable number},{"Deferred Tax", type nullable number},{"Depreciation and Amortization", type nullable number},{"Reported EBITDA", type nullable number},{"Other Income", type nullable number},{"Purchases", type nullable number},{"Inventory Change", type nullable number},{"Material Consumed", type nullable number},{"Equity", type nullable number},{"Long Term Debt", type nullable number},{"Short Term Debt", type nullable number},{"Unsecured Long Term Debt", type nullable number},{"Unsecured Short Term Debt", type nullable number},{"Current Assets", type nullable number},{"Current Liabilities", type nullable number},{"Inventory", type nullable number},{"Debtors", type nullable number},{"Creditors", type nullable number},{"Intangible Assets", type nullable number},{"Retained Earnings Proxy", type nullable number},{"Non Current Liabilities", type nullable number},{"Total Assets", type nullable number}}, "en-US")
in Typed

name: Internal Transfers
description: Consolidated internal-transfer detail from Internal & Group. Separate analytical subset; do not add to Raw Data totals.

  Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Data, {{"Date", type nullable date},{"Month", type nullable date},{"Narration", type text},{"Classification", type text},{"Debit", type nullable number},{"Credit", type nullable number},{"Source Row", type nullable number}}, "en-US")

name: Party Reconciliation
description: Apr-Sep 2024 only. Exact normalized names (punctuation/spacing/case ignored). GST taxable amounts vs gross bank cash flows incl tax, loans and transfers; variance is NOT an outstanding debtor/creditor balance or proof of mismatch. No GSTIN exists in bank source. Unmatched entries retained.
mExpression:
let
  Rows = Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("", BinaryEncoding.Base64), Compression.GZip)),
  Data = Table.FromRows(Rows, {"Month","Party","Party Key","Match Status","GST Sales","GST Purchases","Bank Receipts","Bank Payments","Sales Less Receipts","Purchases Less Payments"}),
  Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Data, {{"Month", type nullable date},{"Party", type text},{"Party Key", type text},{"Match Status", type text},{"GST Sales", type nullable number},{"GST Purchases", type nullable number},{"Bank Receipts", type nullable number},{"Bank Payments", type nullable number},{"Sales Less Receipts", type nullable number},{"Purchases Less Payments", type nullable number}}, "en-US")
in Typed

name: Review Coverage
description: Checklist coverage, definitions and evidence gaps. Missing data is not substituted with fabricated values.
mExpression:
let
  Rows = Json.Document(Binary.Decompress(Binary.FromText("", BinaryEncoding.Base64), Compression.GZip)),
  Data = Table.FromRows(Rows, {"Area","Requirement","Status","Evidence or Gap"}),
  Typed = Table.TransformColumnTypes(Data, {{"Area", type text},{"Requirement", type text},{"Status", type text},{"Evidence or Gap", type text}}, "en-US")
in Typed

description: Month-grain calendar; India April-March financial years. Common Period identifies shared GST/bank April-September 2024 coverage.
